result.title: GAMF-Net: Grouped Availability-Aware Multimodal Fusion for Smartphone Skin Lesion Classification
result.summary: Smartphone clinical images provide a low-cost data source for computer-aided skin lesion classification in resource-constrained settings, but images alone cannot fully capture patients' medical histories and lesion symptoms. To address the lack of structured organization among heterogeneous clinical variables, the ambiguity between observed and imputed values, and the risk that clinical information may interfere with visual evidence, we propose GAMF-Net, a grouped availability-aware multimodal fusion network. Ten clinical variables are divided into three semantic groups---demographics, history-related risk, and lesion presentation---and each group jointly encodes field values and field-level availability masks. The image branch produces the base classification logits, while each clinical group generates image-conditioned class-level residual evidence. Only available groups participate in availability-normalized equal-weight fusion; when all clinical information is unavailable, the model reduces exactly to the image-only pathway. We evaluate the method on PAD-UFES-20 under a patient-disjoint five-fold protocol with separate training, validation, and test partitions. GAMF-Net achieves an Accuracy of $74.17\pm2.85\%$, a balanced accuracy (BACC) of $70.11\pm2.11\%$, a Macro-F1 of $68.85\pm0.85\%$, and a Macro-AUROC of $93.42\pm1.20\%$, outperforming all image-only and multimodal baselines reimplemented under a unified protocol. Compared with the strongest baseline, MetaBlock, the corresponding improvements are 2.37, 2.59, 4.14, and 1.02 percentage points, respectively. Ablation results show that clinical information substantially improves class-balanced performance, constrained equal-weight fusion is more effective than dynamic fusion, and the lesion-presentation group provides the most informative clinical complement.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 GAMF-Net，将十个临床变量按人口学、病史风险、皮损表现分为三组，每组联合编码字段值与可用性掩码；图像分支给出基础分类 logits，各临床组产生以图像为条件的类级残差证据，仅可用组参与可用性归一化的等权融合，临床信息全缺失时严格退化为纯图像通路，并在 PAD-UFES-20 上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其可用性掩码门控的残差式辅助证据融合、以及「辅助信息全部缺失即退化为纯视觉通路」的设计，可能为 LVR 中控制非视觉证据对视觉证据的调制、抑制视觉旁路提供可核查的机制线索，但该文是图像分类任务，不涉及 latent 推理状态或轨迹生成。
